in_sanskrit.name: Vino
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Joy, Delight
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vino एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Vino is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vasana' which means 'Desire' or 'Wish'. The name Vino signifies the joy and delight that comes from fulfilling one's desires. It is also associated with wine, symbolizing the sweetness and abundance that comes from the fruit of one's labor.
